propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epochs must refuse to union at both sync._union_merge and push.py non-FF retry sites, preserving both local and remote refs unchanged
The epoch field in .store-compat.json is a JSON string compared for byte equality only, with value format ISO-8601 UTC instant plus random suffix, never parsed or ordered
Guard placement must distinguish between record-absent and epoch-absent states, abort on mismatch/corrupt/unreadable remote, but permit convergence for matching epochs and behind clones
At sync._union_merge the guard returns without merging; at push.py retry the guard returns immediately from push_tickets_branch without merge or re-push attempts
Remote .store-compat.json is read via git show <remote_ref> not local worktree, with distinct error messages for unreadable ref versus absent file
write_compat_record preserves existing valid string epochs, never generates new epoch values, and treats non-string epochs as corrupt
